# third_party

## Git submodules

Initialize after clone:

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

| Path | Repository |
|------|------------|
| `Vulkan-Headers` | https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers |
| `imgui` | (see `.gitmodules`) |

Vulkan headers install path: `third_party/Vulkan-Headers/include`
